accepted.sentence: In botanical gardens, riders can move between planting beds without causing the soil compaction associated with heavier maintenance vehicles.
On purpose-built dirt tracks, riders race over rollers and berms, developing speed control and balance.
At sprawling industrial sites, staff ride between distant buildings, avoiding fuel use and freeing service vehicles for heavier loads.
During film production, crew members ride quietly between nearby sets, avoiding engine noise that could disrupt location recordings.
A pedal-driven generator converts leg effort into electricity, offering a small-scale way to charge devices during power outages.
In mountain towns, motor assistance can make steep commutes manageable for riders who would otherwise avoid the climb.
A low step-through frame makes mounting easier for riders who cannot comfortably swing a leg over a high top tube.
At large outdoor festivals, staff ride between stages and service areas without navigating vehicle traffic.
